title: 50 Japanese Phrases in 11 Minutes | Learn Japanese for Beginners (Happiness)
description:
Learn 50 essential Japanese phrases in 11 minutes - the fun, fast way.
#Japanese #LearnJapanese #LanguageLearning

Every phrase follows the same rhythm: hear it in English, hear it in 日本語, then say it out loud with the pronunciation guide. Perfect for beginners, travellers and anyone who wants to speak Japanese with confidence.

WHAT YOU GET
- 8 themed chapters, 50 real-life phrases
- 日本語 audio from a native voice
- English pronunciation guide for every line
- A brand-new lesson every single day

PHRASE LIST

HAPPINESS · 幸せ
• Say yes to little pleasures - ちいさな楽しみに はいって言う  [CHIISANA TANOSHIMI ni HAItte IU]
• Choose calm over chaos, today - きょうは 混乱より 落ち着きを選ぶ  [KYOU wa KONRAN yori OCHITSUKI wo ERABU]
• Let your day feel lighter - 今日を もっと軽く感じていい  [KYOU wo MOTTOMO KARUKU KANJITE ii]
• Home smells like comfort, already - 家のにおいが もう安心する  [IE no NIOI ga MOU ANSHIN suru]
• Call someone, just to check in - ひとことでも 誰かに連絡する  [HITO KOTO demo DAREka ni RENRAKU suru]
• Notice birds, not your worries - 不安より 鳥の声に気づく  [FUAN yori TORI no KOE ni KIZUKU]

COURAGE · 勇気
• Courage means taking action anyway - 勇気は、気が進まなくても行動すること  [yūki wa, kiga shinmakunakute mo kōdō suru koto]
• Tell the truth, even softly - やさしくても、ほんとのことを言う  [yasashiku temo, honto no koto o iu]
• Ask for help, it counts - 助けてって言うのも勇気だ  [tasukete tte iu no mo yūki da]
• Break the silence, start talking - 沈黙を破って、まず一言言ってみよう  [chinmoku o yabutte, mazu hitokoto itte miyō]
• Keep your promise, even scared - 怖くても、約束は守る  [kowakute mo, yakusoku wa mamoru]
• Choose the harder kind option - 難しいほうの優しさを選ぶ  [muzukashii hō no yasashisa o erabu]

INNER PEACE · 心の平和
• Soften your shoulders, let go - 肩の力を抜いて、手放そう。  [kata no chikara wo nuite, tebanoso-u.]
• Wash dishes, breathe with the water - 食器を洗いながら、水と一緒に呼吸しよう。  [shokki wo arai nagara, mizu to issho ni koku shiyou.]
• Let worry pass like clouds - 心配は雲みたいに流れていく。  [shinpai wa kumo mitai ni nagarete iku.]
• Choose one kind sentence for you - 自分にやさしいひと言を選ぼう。  [jibun ni yasashii hitokoto wo erabou.]
• Stop fighting, gently return to calm - 抵抗するのをやめて、静けさへ戻ろう。  [teikou suru no o yamete, shizukesa e modorou.]
• Answer slowly, your mind settles - ゆっくり返事して、心が落ち着く。  [yukkuri henji shite, kokoro ga ochitsuku.]

SHOPPING & PRICES · 買い物と値段
• How much is this actually? - これ、いくらですか？  [kore, IKURA desu ka?]
• Do you have a cheaper one? - もっと安いのはありますか？  [MOTTO yasui no wa arimasu ka?]
• Is there a discount today? - 今日、割引はありますか？  [kyou, waribiki wa arimasu ka?]
• Can I use my coupon here? - ここでクーポン使えますか？  [koko de KUUPON tsukaemasu ka?]
• Is it on sale right now? - 今、セール中ですか？  [ima, SEERU chuu desu ka?]
• Does this price include tax? - この値段は税込みですか？  [kono NEDAN wa zeikomi desu ka?]
• What’s the total after everything? - 全部でいくらになりますか？  [zenbu de IKURA ni narimasu ka?]

POSITIVE LIFE · ポジティブな人生
• I can handle today, one moment - 今日を乗り切れる, いまこの瞬間で  [きょう o norikireru, ima kono shunkan de]
• My thoughts shape my next step - 考えが次の一歩を決める  [kangae ga tsugi no ippo o kimeru]
• Small courage counts, even quietly - 小さな勇気も, 静かにちゃんと効く  [chiisana yuuki mo, shizuka ni chanto kiku]
• I choose effort over worry - 心配より, 努力を選ぶ  [shinpai yori, doryoku o erabu]
• Talk kindly, even to myself - 自分にもやさしく話しかけよう  [jibun ni mo yasashiku hanashikakeyou]
• Let your pace be enough - 自分のペースでいい, それで十分  [jibun no peesu de ii, sore de jūbun]

WEATHER & SMALL TALK · 天気と雑談
• How's the weather by you? - そっちは天気どう？  [SOTTA wa tenki dō?]
• It looks like rain today. - 今日は雨っぽいね。  [KYŌ wa ame ppoi ne]
• Did the storm pass yet? - 嵐、もう過ぎた？  [ARASHI, mō sugita?]
• The sky is so clear. - 空がすごく澄んでるね。  [SORA ga sugoku sunden tiru ne]
• It’s warmer than yesterday. - 昨日より暖かいね。  [KINŌ yori atakai ne]
• Looks like a chilly morning. - 今朝は冷えそうだね。  [KEASA wa hiesō da ne]

MAKING PLANS · 計画を立てる
• What should we do next? - 次、何をしようか。  [Ts u, nani o shiyou ka.]
• Let’s pick a date and time. - 日にちと時間を決めよう。  [Hi ni chi to jikan o kimeyou.]
• Can we meet this weekend? - 今週末、会えそう？  [Konshūmatsu, aeesō?]
• I’ll look at calendars after work. - 仕事のあとで予定表を見ます。  [Shigoto no ato de yoteihyō o mimasu.]
• We need a plan for Monday. - 月曜の予定、ちゃんと考えよう。  [Getsuyō no yotei, chanto kangaeyō.]
• How about dinner at 7? - 7時に夕飯はどう？  [Shichi ji ni yūhan wa dō?]

FEELINGS & EMOTIONS · 感情
• I feel uneasy about this. - このことには不安な気持ちになる。  [kono koto ni wa FUdZA na KIMOchi ni naru]
• Right now, I feel relieved. - 今ほっとしてるよ。  [ima HOTto shite ru yo]
• I’m getting annoyed with delays. - 遅れにイライラしちゃう。  [okure ni IRAIRA shi chau]
• I’m secretly jealous of you. - ちょっとだけ、あなたがうらやましい。  [chotto dake, anata ga ura ya mashii]
• That news made me panic. - その知らせでパニックになった。  [sono shirase de paNIKku ni natta]
